title: 연구학교에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Designation, etc.)
(1) Deleted on July 30, 2008.
(2) Where necessary to improve school education generally and promote educational development in a region, the Superintendent of Education may designate a research school upon application by the head of a school. [Amended on July 30, 2008.]
(3) Where the Superintendent of Education designates a research school, the Superintendent shall make the decision in consideration of the relevant school's capacity to conduct research, its research plan, and other matters. [Amended on January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; and July 30, 2008.]
(4) The period of designation as a research school shall be not less than six months and not more than three years, depending on the field and characteristics of the research.
(5) Kindergartens, elementary schools, middle schools, high schools, and special schools attached to national universities shall be permanent research schools, irrespective of designation by the Superintendent of Education. [Amended on January 31, 2001; March 4, 2008; July 30, 2008; and August 30, 2024.]
(6) Where the Minister of Education deems it necessary to promote educational policies, verify textbooks, etc., the Minister may request a Superintendent of Education to designate a research school. In such cases, the Superintendent of Education shall comply with the request unless special grounds exist. [Newly inserted on July 30, 2008; amended on March 23, 2013.]
